verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB is a managed ClickHouse database service, not an agent or assistant, so consuming tools from external MCP servers is outside its product role, and nothing in the evidence shows a built-in agent that could act as an MCP client. Its documented MCP endpoint (docs-7) is server-side: coding agents connect to it. That belongs to the separate MCP-server story and does not make this client axis applicable.
